name: Layer explode
description: The shot shrinks into a card, turns in 3D on a dark ground, and comes apart into its layers like glass panes: the room, the title, the speaker, the sound. Each pane has a thin frame and a label, and the waveform plays along. Then the panes slide back and the card fills the frame.
when: When you explain how a video or a design is built: 'every video is just layers'.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
a clean plate: the room without the speaker (plate.png)
the waveform (wave.js, made in the steps)
